title: Connectors route around shapes, curve, and place their labels clear of the line
body:
`line` and `arrow` (`Connector` in `scene/diagram.rs`) draw one straight segment with a filled triangle head and a label above the midpoint. acre-51488b is a symptom: a label overlaps a vertical arrow.

## Proposal

- `route straight | elbow | curve`: an elbow route turns at right angles, and a curve is a cubic with handles along each end's side.
- `head none | triangle | open | dot` at each end, with `tail` for the start.
- A label placed beside the line on its left or right, clear of the stroke, or at a fraction along it.
